UIFinalizer.cs.role: Central pipeline manager coordinating UIStateBuilder transformations.
responsibilities: Coordinate element updates through the builder chain.

HUDTextElement.cs.role: Individual display element responsible for rendering text blocks.
responsibilities: Draw element text using the provided drawing context.

HUDManager.cs.role: Central manager for HUD layout loading, rendering, and state management.
responsibilities: Load HUD layout JSON via HUDConfigManager.
Manage HUD textures, text elements, and render order.
Maintain hitboxes for cash/lives increment buttons.
